```artifact
Feature: Doctor's Consultation and Prescription Process

Scenario Outline: Doctor views and manages appointments and consultations

  Given a doctor has access to the patient list
  When the doctor views pending appointments
  Then the doctor can provide consultation

  Given a doctor has access to the patient list
  When the doctor views consultations
  Then the doctor can prescribe medicines

  Given a doctor has access to the patient list
  When the doctor views lab tests
  Then the doctor can prescribe lab tests

  Given a doctor has access to the patient list
  When the doctor views medicines
  Then the doctor can request delivery

  Given a doctor has access to the patient list
  When the doctor views lab reports
  Then the doctor can release lab reports


Examples:
  | Appointment Status | Consultation Action | Lab Test Action | Medicine Action | Lab Report Action |
  | Pending           | Provide Consultation  | Prescribe Lab Test | Prescribe Medicine | Request Delivery | Release Lab Report |
  | Completed         | Provide Consultation  | Prescribe Lab Test | Prescribe Medicine | Request Delivery | Release Lab Report |
  | Cancelled         | Provide Consultation  | Prescribe Lab Test | Prescribe Medicine | Request Delivery | Release Lab Report |


Scenario Outline: Doctor performs lab tests and prescribes medicines

  Given a doctor has access to the patient list
  When the doctor performs lab tests
  Then the lab report is updated

  Given a doctor has access to the patient list
  When the doctor prescribes medicines
  Then the medicine request is sent


Examples:
  | Lab Test Status | Medicine Prescription Status |
  | Pending           | Sent                         |
  | Completed         | Sent                         |
  | Cancelled         | Sent                         |

Scenario Outline: Lab report release and medicine request

  Given a doctor has access to the patient list
  When the doctor releases lab reports
  Then the lab report is available for view

  Given a doctor has access to the patient list
  When the doctor requests medicine delivery
  Then the medicine request is sent


Examples:
  | Lab Report Status | Medicine Request Status |
  | Available for View | Sent                         |
  | Not Available for View | Sent                         |

```
